name: Fallen Moonstone
summary: A Fallen Moonstone is a luminous, magically charged stone gathered from the tranquil waters of Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale. Imbued with sacred lunar energy, these stones possess potent restorative properties capable of renewing vitality and curing severe frailty.

sections.title: Gifts of the Night Sky
sections.body: Fallen Moonstones were once gathered in abundance along the shores and shallows of Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar. Highly treasured by the night elves for their restorative magic and lunar blessing, they were often sought out to aid in recovery when ordinary remedies proved insufficient. However, harvesting them became treacherous when corrupt Shadethicket woodkin overran the lake. Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, hoarded every stone it could find on a small central island, cutting off the local Kaldorei from a vital source of healing.

sections.title: A Father's Salvation
sections.body: When young Relara Whitemoon fell gravely ill in Astranaar, ordinary treatments broke her fever but left her faded and clinging to life with only a few breaths remaining. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, realized that only the concentrated restorative power of a moonstone could renew her depleted vitality. Recovering a stone from the Shadethicket Oracle's hoard provided the spark needed to save the child's life.

faq.answer: It is a rare, glowing stone found at Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale. Saturated with lunar magic, it possesses potent restorative energy that the night elves use to replenish strength in the severely weakened.

They originate at Fallen Sky Lake, located southeast of Astranaar in Ashenvale. While they once dotted the lake bed freely, the hostile Shadethicket woodkin collected and hoarded them on an island in the lake's center.

faq.q: Who possesses the moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle, the leader of the corrupted woodkin residing at Fallen Sky Lake, hoarded the fallen moonstones on an island in the middle of the lake.

faq.q: Why does Pelturas Whitemoon need a Fallen Moonstone?
faq.answer: His young daughter, Relara, survived a debilitating fever but was left critically frail and fading fast. Pelturas recognized that natural rest would not suffice to keep her alive, requiring the innate magic of a moonstone to restore her vigor.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, relics tied to the radiance of Elune are sacred instruments of preservation, offering divine healing when mortal medicine fails.
Devotees of the Sisterhood of Elune recognize the lunar luminescence of these stones as a tangible manifestation of healing grace.
